name: Queen
source:
Fine, known as Queen is the head of Sect Queencroiz and formal antagonist of the story. She wishes to bring the End and rebuild the world there would be no fighting.

[spoiler]Her parents died during the Last war. After that Fine decided to gather her own group and end all the fighting. But after the war with Sect Falcon her personality start to change quite drastically.[/spoiler]
translation:
Fine, known as Queen is the head of Sect Queencroiz and formal antagonist of the story. She wishes to bring the End and rebuild the world there would be no fighting.

[spoiler]Her parents died during the Last war. After that Fine decided to gather her own group and end all the fighting. But after the war with Sect Falcon her personality start to change quite drastically.[/spoiler]
